title: MAVOS-DD: Multilingual Audio-Video Open-Set Deepfake Detection Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2505.11109v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present the first large-scale open-set benchmark for multilingual audio-video deepfake detection. Our dataset comprises nearly 350 hours of real and fake videos across eight languages, with 59% of data being generated. For each language, the fake videos are generated with several distinct audio and video deepfake generation models, selected based on their quality, via visual inspection. We organize the training, validation and test splits such that only a subset of the chosen generative models and languages are available during training, thus creating several challenging open-set evaluation setups. We perform experiments with various pre-trained and fine-tuned deepfake detectors proposed in recent literature. Our results show that state-of-the-art detectors are not currently able to maintain their performance levels when tested in our open-set scenarios. We publicly release our data and code for non-commercial use at https:/

translated_title: MAVOS-DD：多语言音视频开放集深度伪造检测基准
translated_abstract: 我们提出了首个用于多语言音视频深度伪造检测的大规模开放集基准。我们的数据集包含近350小时、涵盖八种语言的真实和伪造视频，其中59%的数据为生成数据。对于每种语言，伪造视频均由多个不同的音频和视频深度伪造生成模型生成，这些模型是通过人工视觉检查并依据其生成质量挑选的。我们对训练集、验证集和测试集的划分方式进行了组织，使得训练阶段仅能接触到所选生成模型和语言的一个子集，从而构建了多个具有挑战性的开放集评估场景。我们使用近期文献中提出的多种预训练和微调深度伪造检测器进行了实验。结果表明，目前最先进的检测器在我们的开放集场景下测试时无法保持其原有性能水平。我们以非商业用途公开发布了我们的数据和代码。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个大规模多语言音视频开放集深度伪造检测基准MAVOS-DD，包含八种语言近350小时的真实与伪造视频，实验表明现有最先进的检测器在开放集场景下无法维持其性能水平。
en_tdlr: The paper presents MAVOS-DD, the first large-scale open-set benchmark for multilingual audio-video deepfake detection, comprising nearly 350 hours of real and fake videos across eight languages, and shows that state-of-the-art detectors fail to maintain their performance in open-set scenarios.
